hardRules: Age eligibility is a hard constraint unless a program explicitly covers all ages.
Explicit event dates outrank generic weekday labels.
A program must never be silently moved to another location to improve a recommendation.
Partner ownership must not reduce relevance when the partner program is the best fit.
Pain-point and root-cause concepts are matching concepts, not medical diagnoses.

sourceAuthority.registrationRule: Use Wix for operational/current registration facts only where Wix is authoritative for that field. For explicit external-registration programs use the external canonical program source first.

doNotInfer: Do not infer that BMI is a conventional full-time or compulsory Austrian school.
Do not infer accreditation, formal grades or a conventional timetable unless explicitly sourced.
Do not infer employment from a teacher/activity-leader profile; use professional affiliation unless employment is explicitly sourced.
Do not invent missing dates, fees, locations, qualifications, achievements, legal status, availability, ownership or Wikidata Q-IDs.
